cohort: 265 children with first episode of wheezing diagnosed as bronchiolitis and tested for RSV.
finding: Children born by elective cesarean delivery had double the odds of RSV-positive detection compared to vaginal delivery, even after adjusting for age, birth season, maternal asthma, and family smoking status.
mod_finding: Children born by elective cesarean delivery had double the odds of RSV-positive detection compared to vaginal delivery (adjusted odds ratio 2.32; 95% confidence interval 1.19-4.52).
followup_time: Majority of children (83.3%) were younger than 12 months
